source_findings.confirmed: The locked LVGL zero-throw aligned release sends SCROLL_END while indev.scroll_obj is still carousel; it clears the pointer only after END. With zero snap delta there is no animation/final END. Old shell busy guard skipped navigation/dot commit and loop-clone recenter.
source_findings.baseline_reproduction: Real locked SDK lv_indev_scroll_throw_handler, target x780 with zero throw: x780/page0/right1170 and expected page1 assertion fails. This proves missed commit, not persistent one-way touch restriction.
source_findings.remaining: Ordinary next gesture recomputes bounds; stale page alone does not prove persistent one-way restriction. No actual hidden/moved clone evidence. Original state was replaced before capture. Long-off restore is a possible route to face, not a proved actual cause.

change.settle: Keep immediate commit for idle END. Busy END arms one paused 1ms LVGL timer; callback pauses first and commits only after indev/animation is idle. Active animation waits for its final END to re-arm; no polling. Rebuild pauses it, destroy removes it after ready=false.
change.diagnostics: UI-thread read-only snapshot: time/surface/display/page, x/left/right, endpoint geometry+hidden/floating/snappable flags, dot container present/visible/selected counts, scroll/settle/transition guards. Mismatch bits1position/2page/4dots/8extent/16endpoints only when settled HOME.

Cache can remain pre-OFF and is labelled with sample time. RAM-only, lost on reboot.
